title: Locarno Treaties
summary: A set of agreements negotiated at Locarno in October 1925 and signed in London on 1 December. Germany, France, Belgium, Britain and Italy guaranteed peace in western Europe and Germany's western frontiers, while eastern borders were left to arbitration. The pact fostered a 'spirit of Locarno' and was broken when German troops entered the Rhineland in 1936.
